messages:
elaine: Hey @harish @tom — need a short-lived admin session for a log probe. We received a GDPR DSAR and need to verify deletion for a user. Goal: read-only access to app logs in prod, 2d window. No exports. Jira INFRA-4821. Requesting break-glass for 3h to run queries and redact PII before posting results.

harish: Approved in principle. Please clarify exact log scope (service names, clusters), list of people who will access, and confirm duration (max 4h). Also note we require audit steps captured.

elaine: Scope: session-api service only, prod cluster `us-east1-prod`, time window 2026-03-10T00:00Z to 2026-03-11T00:00Z. Accessors: elaine + tom. Duration 3h. I will not export raw logs outside the secure environment. Adding Jira link: https://jira.redwood/INFRA-4821 — will attach queries.

tom: +1 from infra. For redaction, use the sanctioned script `redact-logs --pii-mask` in the secure bastion. Run in the ephemeral container and produce a redacted artifact only. Quick example: ```export LOG_QUERY=\"resource.type=k8s_container AND labels.app=session-api\"\ngcloud logging read \"$LOG_QUERY\" --start=\"2026-03-10T00:00:00Z\" --end=\"2026-03-11T00:00:00Z\" --project=redwood-prod --limit=10000 > /tmp/raw.log\nredact-logs /tmp/raw.log > /tmp/redacted.log```

security-bot: break-glass request recorded: ID bg-20260310-01 by elaine. Security on-call automatically notified. Pending manual role issuance. Reminder: follow the break-glass runbook and attach audit log.

harish: Creating a temporary role `prod-log-reader` scoped to `projects/redwood-prod/logs.session-api` and issuing an ephemeral token. This will include mandatory audit logging and will be revoked after window. Reminder: do not copy raw logs into personal storage.

liz: Legal checked — DSAR review of logs allowed under current policy for account verification. Please document the steps taken and upload the redacted artifact to the ticket.

ops-oncall: Temporary role applied. Access window: starts 1769004321, scheduled end 1769005400 (3h). Ephemeral CLI token issued to elaine and tom. If you finish early, ping us to revoke immediately.

elaine: Received the token, starting session now. Will post the redacted snippet to INFRA-4821 and tag this thread. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
